## Función de densidad

$$f(k) = p^k(1-p)^{1-p}, \ k\in \{0,1\}$$

Sea $X = Be(p=0.7)$, la distribución que modela la probabilidad de obtener una cara usando una moneda trucada.

### En `R`

```{r}
library(Rlab)

dbern(0, prob = 0.7)
dbern(1, prob = 0.7)
pbern(0, prob = 0.7)
pbern(1, prob = 0.7)
qbern(0.5, prob = 0.7)
qbern(0.25, prob = 0.7)
rbern(100, prob = 0.7) -> data
hist(data)
```

### En `Python`

```{python}
from scipy.stats import bernoulli
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

p = 0.7
mean, var, skew, kurt = bernoulli.stats(p, moments="mvsk")
print("Media = {}".format(mean))
print("Varianza = {}".format(var))
print("Sesgo = {}".format(skew))
print("Curtosis = {}".format(kurt))

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 1)
x = bernoulli.rvs(p, size=1000)
ax.hist(x)
plt.show()
```
